credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Half-length portrait of O'Keeffe sitting in a high back chair on the portal wearing a light colored wrap dress and a white head scarf which conceals her hair; a cow skull hangs on the adobe wall behind her along with a wooden shelf containing a backbone and other large bone fragments, what appears to be a large primed canvas is leaning against the shelf  behind her chair
title: Georgia O'Keeffe on Portal at the Ghost Ranch, New Mexico
